title: 第2025章 陆玄之力第2024章 陆玄降临了
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: “这是怎么了？”
小囡囡的大眼睛瞪得很大。
她被眼前的一幕吓到了。
目之所及，都是诡族强者和人族的尸体。
到处都是黑色的血液。
那些残破的阵纹，发出“噼里啪啦”的声音，如同闪电在交织。
这一战太恐怖了。
连星空都被打碎了！
诡异之力弥漫整个空间。
小囡囡不由得捂住了鼻子。
这股气息她太讨厌了。
而这时，当风厉长老等人看到陆玄和小囡囡的降临，直接震惊在原地。
“什么情况？是陆玄来了！”
“怎么可能！”
“这下该如何是好？”
所有诡族都慌了。
陆玄两个字的重量太大了。
哪怕他们是低星道尊境，也感到内心瑟瑟发抖。
这几乎是一种本能！
要知道上一次在猎杀杨坚的时候，苍兀老祖出手，也遇到了陆玄，都没能拿回来人皮卷！
而张奎统领等人直接瞪大了眼睛。
“是陆尊主！”
“我们有救了！”
他们完全松了一口气。
只要陆尊主在，什么道尊境也无妨，哪怕是苍兀老祖亲临，也夺不走空间通道。
沉寂一瞬。
风厉长老的脸色变得愈发阴冷。
他咬牙切齿，向着旁边一个黑袍长老看去，“你过去杀了陆玄！”
黑袍长老直接愣住了，他看了看风厉长老，然后又看了看陆玄，“我？去杀了陆玄？”
不是。
他何德何能啊？
但风厉长老冷哼一声，“你不出手，陆玄就不会对我们出手吗？”
黑袍长老咽了一口黑色唾沫，“我再带几个人。”
他马上看向身旁的几人。
“走！一起试试陆玄的深浅！”
“玛德，拼了！”
“不说杀了陆玄，只要能伤到陆玄，我们也能在大宇中留名了！”
闻言，几人也变得振奋了起来。
是啊，玛德！
这可是陆玄啊！
虽然虎落平阳，但是合该被他们欺负啊！
黑袍长老脸上露出了一丝狰狞变态的兴奋，强压着心中的恐惧。
向着陆玄杀了过来！

"What's going on?"
The little girl's big eyes widened.
She was frightened by what she saw.
As far as the eye can see, there are corpses of powerful people from the Kuai clan and humans.
There was black blood everywhere.
Those broken formations made a "crackling" sound, like lightning intertwining.
This battle was too terrifying.
Even the starry sky was shattered!
Weird power permeated the entire space.
The little girl couldn't help but cover her nose.
She hated this smell so much.
At this time, when Elder Feng Li and others saw the arrival of Lu Xuan and Xiao Nannan, they were immediately shocked.
"What's going on? Lu Xuan is here!"
"How is that possible!"
"What should I do now?"
All the Kuai tribe panicked.
The weight of the word "Lu Xuan" is too great.
Even if they are in the low-star Taoist realm, they still feel trembling inside.
It's almost instinctive!
You must know that the last time when he was hunting Yang Jian, Patriarch Cangwu took action and met Lu Xuan, but he failed to get back the human skin scroll!
Commander Zhang Kui and others' eyes widened.
"It's Lord Lu!"
"We are saved!"
They were completely relieved.
As long as Lord Lu is here, it doesn't matter what Taoist realm is. Even if Ancestor Cangwu comes in person, he can't take away the space passage.
There was silence for a moment.
Elder Feng Li's expression became even colder.
He gritted his teeth and looked at the black-robed elder next to him, "Go over and kill Lu Xuan!"
The black-robed elder was stunned. He looked at Elder Fengli, and then at Lu Xuan, "Me? Are you going to kill Lu Xuan?"
No.
How virtuous and capable is he?
But Elder Feng Li snorted coldly, "If you don't take action, won't Lu Xuan take action against us?"
The black-robed elder swallowed a mouthful of black saliva and said, "I will bring a few more people."
He immediately looked at the people beside him.
"Let's go! Let's try Lu Xuan's depth together!"
"Made, fight!"
"Not to mention killing Lu Xuan, as long as we can hurt Lu Xuan, we can leave our name in the universe!"
Hearing this, several people also became excited.
Yes, Mad!
This is Lu Xuan!
Although the tiger has fallen into peace, He should be bullied by them!
"Kill!"
The black-robed elder showed a hint of ferocious excitement on his face, suppressing the fear in his heart.
He came to kill Lu Xuan!
